title: Reliable updates
summary: Behind-the-scenes work so that intranet updates are installed safely, with an automatic return to the previous version if something goes wrong.

changed: Updates are installed in one step, with a backup first and an automatic return to the previous version if the checks fail.

internal_notes: Added the read-only Cloudron preflight check and the one-command deploy script with rollback.
Documented the production sign-in client set-up.
